raw_text:
{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept NACK-ish: notes rebroadcasting incoming txs helps confirmation and is needed for CPFP; suggests a node rebroadcast pool"
    },
    {
      "login": "instagibbs",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "linked past rebroadcast pool PRs and suggested opening an issue to compare alternatives"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK, suggested making the behavior configurable"
    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "demonstrated regression where wallet CPFP child transactions fail to re-enter mempool or rebroadcast after restart or mempool expiry"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5936779475",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Rebroadcasting incoming transactions is useful to help get them confirmed",
      "quote": "Rebroadcasting transactions that are not ours is useful as rebroadcasting does have an effect on getting such transactions confirmed.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author argued manual rebroadcast via #36481 protects passive users from deanonymization attacks",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6690246250"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6690246250",
      "status_by_quote": "it would be justified to have users who actually got paid and need rebroadcasting do manual steps if that protects passive users from getting deanonymized"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5936779475",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Incoming transactions must be in the mempool for the wallet to CPFP them",
      "quote": "Furthermore, if we want to CPFP a transaction, it needs to be in our mempool first, otherwise the wallet will be unable to broadcast the child.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author noted user can resubmit parent via #36481 first and proposed resubmitting in-wallet parents of wallet-created transactions",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6690246250"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6690246250",
      "status_by_quote": "The same applies to CPFP: if the parent has dropped out of our mempool, the user can rebroadcast it via #36481 first."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5936779475",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider enabling rebroadcasting in a privacy-preserving manner, such as a node rebroadcast pool, rather than deleting it",
      "quote": "Instead of trying to delete rebroadcasting in the name of privacy, we should consider other ways to enable rebroadcasting in a privacy preserving manner, such as a rebroadcast pool in the node.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that alternative approaches like #36482 do not fix the attack scenario",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6690246250"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6690246250",
      "status_by_quote": "Unfortunately, this issue is not fixed by #36482: that approach would just require a few extra steps from the attacker"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5937194951",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Start a fresh issue to lay down and compare rebroadcast alternatives side by side",
      "quote": "I think we need to start a fresh issue on the topic and lay down alternatives side by side",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "achow101 opened issue #36403 for discussion",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5939298900"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5939298900",
      "status_by_quote": "I've opened #36403 where we can have more high level discussion about transaction rebroadcast in general."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6012406070",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Make the behavior configurable (such as extending -walletbroadcast) so users can decide what fits their priorities",
      "quote": "Concept ACK, but make this configurable somehow.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6397012438",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A CPFP child created by the wallet stays out of the mempool and is not rebroadcast after a restart without mempool.dat or mempool expiry because its unconfirmed parent is skipped",
      "quote": "After a restart without mempool.dat, or after mempool expiry, a CPFP child that the wallet itself created for an incoming payment stays out of the mempool on this branch, and no resend timer brings it",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author offered to change the logic to resubmit unconfirmed in-wallet parents of wallet-created transactions",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6690246250"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6690246250",
      "status_by_quote": "I could change the logic to also resubmit unconfirmed in-wallet parents of transactions we created."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6012406070",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "no reason given: make this configurable somehow to let users decide what is best for them",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author replied to achow101 and fametrano in c:6690246250, defending the trade-off against passive deanonymization and suggesting a logic change to resubmit unconfirmed in-wallet parents of wallet-created transactions to resolve CPFP issues.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "achow101 and fametrano to respond to author's rationale and proposed logic change for CPFP parent resubmission",
      "id": "c:6690246250"
    },
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address vasild's suggestion to make the behavior configurable",
      "id": "c:6012406070"
    }
  ]
}
